component.name: LibreLinkUp Rust Desktop
component.summary: KDE Plasma 6 Blood Glucose Monitor for LibreLinkUp

description.p: Native Rust + KDE Plasma 6 Kirigami desktop client for monitoring continuous glucose readings from LibreLinkUp.

ul.li: Dynamic system tray badge showing live blood glucose value and/or rich hover tooltip
Native KDE Plasma 6 Light, Dark, and System theme support
Interactive 12-hour CGM trend graph with point hover inspection
Floating desktop overlay widget with Dark Theme and adjustable transparency
Built-in diagnostic Log Viewer with filtering, search, and export
